messages.subject: speed vs speeds
parts:
Hi Chris!  

With my Barren-ground caribou telemetry data, there is a strong velocity autocorrelation signature and thus, I am able to calculate speed and speeds for my datasets!  Can you elaborate on the difference between the speed and speeds function.  In the package pdf it describes speed computing the time-averaged speed and speeds the instantaneous speeds at a specified array of times.  I would have thought that the average of the speeds results would be the same as the time-averaged speed across the trajectory but that isn't the case.  What am I missing?  

Thanks!  looking forward to meeting you in person at Animove this August!  

Robin

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: speed vs speeds
parts:
Hi Robin,

With fast=FALSE and a high enough sampling frequency, the average of speeds() should produce the same point estimate as speed(). However, even in that limit speeds() cannot give you the correct confidence intervals of speed(), because the speeds() estimates are correlated in time.

Best,
Chris
